note.p: Samuel Bagster, 1772-1851, was a bookseller apprenticed to Otridge in St Clement Danes at a price of £100 in 1787. His parents were George, 1739-1820, and his mother Mary Denton. He married Emma Birch in 1797 and took apprentice with John Lepard in 1804. He was a bookseller between 1802 and 1811 at 81 Strand. He was the founder of the publisher Bagster and Sons. In 1816, Bagster bought out the English polyglot version of the Bible which was a success.
